name: empty-plan
source: docs/decisions/0030-self-contained-plan-file.md, Active sections are computed. A plan with no sections has no active section

name: plain-sections
source: ordering.md: the smaller id comes first. docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section with no enabled field and no includeIf is always active

name: include-if-holds
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Section conditions. Section ids from docs/reference/examples/acme

name: include-if-unanswered
source: conditions.md: unanswered means out. Every test except isSettled is false, before any negation, so isNot is false too

name: include-if-deferred
source: docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: a condition tests settled answers only. isSettled false holds for a deferred answer

name: include-if-empty-text
source: docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: empty text is unanswered

name: include-if-every-clause
source: conditions.md: all is a list of clauses that must all be true

name: include-if-no-clauses
source: conditions.md, Lint warnings: a condition with no clauses always holds, the same as no condition

name: include-if-scope
source: conditions.md: a bare name is a question in the same section. contracts/condition/evaluator/contract.md: scope is where the condition is written

name: include-if-ignores-defaults
source: conditions.md: a declared default is not stored until a person selects it, so it does not count

name: switch-per-section
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: the plan section carries an optional boolean enabled, true when absent. A section is active when its switch is on

name: switch-keeps-answers
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: turning a section off keeps its answers, and they play no part. The switch is outside the questions and the answers

name: switch-and-include-if
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section is active when its includeIf holds, or it has none, and its switch is on. docs/glossary.md, Active section

name: enabled-variable-is-ordinary
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a variable named enabled is not the switch. A plan answer, a section answer, or a default under that name switches nothing. Only the section's own enabled field does

name: after-section-switched-off
source: ordering.md, Dependencies: a listed section that is not active is ignored. docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section whose switch is off is not active

name: include-if-switch-clause
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section clause holds when that section's switch equals enabled. An absent switch is on

name: include-if-switch-clause-unknown
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: the switches are those of the plan's sections, and an absent switch is on. The plan validator reports an unknown section, the selector does not

name: include-if-switch-clause-mixed
source: conditions.md: all is a list of clauses that must all be true. docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a question clause and a section clause are two forms of clause

name: include-if-switch-clause-tests-switch-only
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: the clause tests the switch only. It does not ask whether that section's includeIf holds

name: include-if-switch-clause-cycle
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: the clause tests the switch only, so a cycle between sections cannot happen. Sections that name each other, or themselves, are all active when their switches hold

name: include-if-switch-clause-scope
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: section is the id of another section in the plan, as written. No scope prefix applies, unlike a question name

name: after-section-switch-clause
source: ordering.md, Dependencies: a listed section that is not active is ignored. docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section that depends on a switched-off section is out

name: timing-order
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/ordering.md, Timing and How the order is computed step 1. Ids run against the timing order on purpose

name: timing-default
source: ordering.md: anytime is the default when timing is omitted, and it comes last

name: timing-default-interleaved
source: ordering.md: anytime is the default when timing is omitted. A section with no timing and a section with timing anytime are one group, ordered by id

name: id-order
source: ordering.md step 2: the smaller id comes first. Chosen: ids compare byte by byte, see Decisions to know

name: repeated-timings
source: ordering.md step 1 and 2: sections of one timing are ordered by id inside that timing

name: after-moves-later
source: ordering.md step 2: place each section after every section it lists, and where nothing constrains two sections the smaller id comes first

name: after-chain
source: ordering.md, Dependencies

name: after-several
source: ordering.md step 2: after lists several sections. A section is placed when every one of them is placed

name: after-repeated-entries
source: ordering.md: after is a list of template ids. A repeated id means the same as one

name: after-across-timings
source: ordering.md: sort by timing first. A timing conflict is reported by the plan validator. Chosen: timing wins, see Decisions to know

name: after-across-timings-loop
source: ordering.md: timing first. The two sections are in different timings, so after does not link them

name: after-section-left-out
source: ordering.md, Dependencies: a listed section that is not active is ignored. It does not link the sections around it

name: after-unknown-id
source: ordering.md, What the validators check: an unknown reference is reported by the validator. Chosen: the selector ignores it, see Decisions to know

name: after-itself
source: ordering.md, What the validators check: a self reference is reported by the validator. Chosen: the selector ignores it, see Decisions to know

name: after-cycle-pair
source: ordering.md, What the validators check: a dependency cycle is reported by the validator. Chosen order, see Decisions to know

name: after-cycle-plan-order
source: ordering.md, What the validators check: a dependency cycle is reported by the validator. Chosen order, see Decisions to know: the smallest remaining id goes next, whatever order the plan lists the sections in

name: after-cycle-with-dependent
source: ordering.md, What the validators check: a dependency cycle. Chosen order, see Decisions to know

name: acme
source: docs/reference/examples/acme: a software team gets access, clone-and-run-tests and stuck-general. review-design-system is out by includeIf

name: full-section
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Section: a returned section has every field of the plan's section as held, and no default is filled in. The enabled field, set or absent, comes back as held

name: sub-one-level
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: a sub-section comes directly after its parent, not where its id would sort

name: sub-two-levels
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: a grandchild comes after its parent and before the parent's later sibling, whatever the ids

name: sub-three-levels
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order, depth first: each sub-section is followed by its whole subtree before its next sibling

name: sub-same-parent-many-children
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: siblings by the selector's rules, each followed by its subtree. Plan lists the children and grandchildren out of order

name: sub-listed-before-parent
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section is active by its parent, wherever the plan lists the parent

name: sub-siblings-timings
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: siblings by timing, a sub-section with none takes its parent's. ordering.md: the five timings in order

name: sub-timing-inherited-through-levels
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, takes its parent's timing when it has none. A parent with none takes its own parent's in turn (chosen reading, see Decisions to know)

name: sub-siblings-after
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: after among siblings. ordering.md: a section goes after the sections it lists

name: sub-siblings-after-cycle
source: ordering.md: a cycle in after, applied among siblings. Chosen order as for roots, see Decisions to know in the contract

name: sub-after-across-timings
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md and ordering.md: after never moves a section across a timing line, applied among siblings

name: sub-after-names-nonsibling
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: an after id that is not a sibling is ignored like any non-matching id

name: sub-timing-earlier-than-parent
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section never moves a root across a timing line: it follows its parent whatever its own timing

name: sub-timing-later-than-parent
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section follows its parent directly, before a root of an earlier timing than its own

name: sub-parent-switched-off
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Switches cascade: turning a section off turns off its sub-sections

name: sub-switch-cascade
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Switches cascade at every depth, and a switched-on sub-section under a switched-off ancestor stays out

name: sub-off-alone
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section can be turned off alone: its parent and siblings stay, its own sub-sections go

name: sub-parent-excluded-by-include-if
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section is active only if its parent is active, by the parent's includeIf too, even when its own includeIf holds

name: sub-include-if-parent-answer-true
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, example: access-request has an includeIf on its parent's answer. The parent's answers are read as stored

name: sub-include-if-parent-answer-false
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, example: an answer of no puts the sub-section out. isNot holds for a settled answer that differs

name: sub-include-if-parent-answer-unanswered
source: conditions.md: an unanswered question makes every test except isSettled false, before negation. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, the parent's answers

name: sub-include-if-grandparent-answer
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section's includeIf may name questions of its ancestors, a grandparent's included

name: sub-include-if-own-scope
source: conditions.md: a bare name is a question in the same section. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, the section's own id is the scope, not its parent's

name: sub-include-if-plan-variable
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, A sub-section's includeIf may still name plan variables

name: sub-include-if-unrelated-answer
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md and the selector's rule: no restriction is added, the condition goes to the evaluator as written. The plan validator reports a reference that is not up the tree

name: sub-parent-missing
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Consequences: the plan validator checks the parent exists. The selector treats a parent that is not a section of the plan as making the section inactive (chosen, see Decisions to know in the contract)

name: sub-parent-itself
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, no cycle is possible in a valid plan. A section that names itself as parent is inactive with its sub-sections (chosen, see Decisions to know in the contract)

name: sub-parent-cycle-two
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, as for sub-parent-itself: every section on a cycle and below it is inactive

name: sub-parent-cycle-three
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, as for sub-parent-itself: a cycle of three and the sections below it are inactive, the tree beside it is not

name: sub-switch-clause-reads-own-switch
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Switches cascade, and docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a section clause tests the named section's own switch, not its activity

name: sub-empty-parent-is-root
source: docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md: a section with no parent is a root. An empty parent is the same as none (chosen, see Decisions to know in the contract)

name: sub-full-section
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Section: a returned section has every field as held, no default filled in. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md: the parent is part of the section's content
